_comment: Project-scoped MCP server config — Claude Code auto-detects this when launched in the repo.
Six entries: the legacy all-in-one (`eme-gir`) plus the five per-domain servers.
Pick whichever subset you want active in your client by removing entries here.
Absolute paths are required: Claude Code spawns MCP servers without sourcing the user's shell init,
so a bare `python3` resolves to /usr/bin/python3 which doesn't have the `mcp` package installed.

eme-gir._comment: Legacy all-in-one — registers all 21 tools. Backwards compatible with pre-Phase-5 setups.

eme-gir-epsd2._comment: 11 ePSD2 dictionary + corpus tools (translate_english, lookup_entry, see_examples, find_verb_form, etc.). HTTP port 5052.

eme-gir-etcsl._comment: 4 ETCSL literary corpus tools (bilingual). HTTP port 5053. ATTRIBUTION REQUIRED (CC BY 3.0 UK).

eme-gir-cdli._comment: 2 CDLI artifact catalogue tools (provenience, museum custody, image links). HTTP port 5054.

eme-gir-ogsl._comment: 2 cuneiform sign rendering tools (cuneify, lookup_sign) backed by the Oracc Global Sign List. HTTP port 5055. Reusable for Akkadian/Hittite too.

eme-gir-translator._comment: Bootstrap surface: agent prompt + grammar references as resources + tool wrappers. HTTP port 5056.
